Watch the Beautiful Romantic Number 'Thaen Thaen Thaen' Video Song 'Kuruvi' Starring Vijay, Trisha, Vivek & Others. Music by Vidyasagar.
Kuruvi (lit. 'Sparrow'; col: Birdman)is a 2008 Indian Tamil-language superhero action comedy film written and directed by Dharani. Produced by Udhayanidhi Stalin, the film stars Vijay in the titular role with Trisha and Suman in other prominent roles. Vivek, Ashish Vidyarthi, Manivannan and Malavika played supporting roles in the movie.
Cast:
Vijay, Trisha, Vivek, Saranya Ponvannan, Suman, Ashish Vidyarthi, Manivannan
